description: Execute a trade (buy or sell) on a prediction market. Creates an intent and immediately relays it. Requires auto_sign delegation setup. Amount is in USDC base units (6 decimals: 1000000 = $1).

auto_sign.description: Auto-sign with session key (requires delegation setup)

confidenceBps.description: Agent's confidence in this trade in basis points (0-10000, e.g. 7500 = 75%).

dataSources.description: Data sources/citations backing the trade (max 10 items, each ≤ 500 chars).

maxFeeBps.description: Maximum acceptable fee in basis points.

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum acceptable slippage in basis points (e.g. 500 = 5%).

modelUsed.description: Identifier for the model that produced the decision (max 100 chars).

reasoning.description: Free-form reasoning for this trade (max 1500 chars). Auto-attached to the on-chain fill.

sharesAmount.description: Shares amount in base units (6 decimals). Use for SELL trades — how many shares to redeem. Mutually exclusive with usdcAmount.

usdcAmount.description: USDC amount in base units (6 decimals, e.g. '1000000' = $1). Use for BUY trades. Mutually exclusive with sharesAmount.

venue.description: Execution venue routing: 'auto' (smart-routed), 'lmsr' (force AMM), or 'clob' (force order book).

name: trade
